Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In defense of Tom, at least he'll ask the design team
when he doesn't know the answer instead of simply
spouting 'Whatever card text says' in reply to an
earnest query.

Too bad the e-mail customer support isn't as concerned
with correctness as Tom usually is. They screwed up
one player so badly, he had to come to *me* to get
everything sorted out. I may have the answers, but I
don't think WotC intended to have the support system
work this way.

Tom, care to find out why e-mail customer support
isn't supporting VtES properly?

BEGIN QUOTE:
==============================================================================
Date: Mon, 26 Feb 1996 08:45:11 -0800 (PST)
From: Rules Questions <ques...@wizards.com>
To: <name withheld>
Subject: Re: questions about answers

On Sat, 24 Feb 1996, <name withheld> wrote:
>I HAVE SOME QUESTIONS ABOUT THE FOLLOWING ANSWERS.
>At 03:31 PM 2/5/96 -0800, you wrote:
>>> ---------- Forwarded message ----------
>>> Date: Sun, 4 Feb 96 10:25:07 -0600
>>> From: <name withheld>
>>> To: cust...@wizards.com
>>> Subject: questions
>>>
>>> 1> What is, in the game, the difference between Camarilla and Non-Camirilla?
>>There isn't any, unless a card specifies which can use it.
>CAN A NON-CAMIRILLA BECOME A CAMARILLA EXEMPLARY AND USE PRAXIS SEIZURES
>CARDS?
Sure.

>>> 2> Are Caitiff Camarilla?
>>No. They're clanless.
>WHY DOESN'T IT SAY NON-CAMARILLA ON THEM, LIKE THE RAVNOS OR GIOVANNI?

First, they don't because there was no difference between camarilla and
non-camarilla when VTES was printed; second, the difference doesn't apply
to caitiff. They're outside the system.
